title: Mazda CMU bench
snapshot_note: Saved progress, not live telemetry. Reopen the private Page for a newer snapshot.
headline: Stock restart and recovery-data persistence verified
summary: One stock software restart and one login confirmed a new boot, the exact original file, read-only root and surviving recovery data. The stock warning was visible for about4.2–4.6s including fade. The observer missed a logger-prefixed banner; a separate agent postflight completed verification and preserved its original UNKNOWN record.

current.console: Fresh postboot root55 / NA access verified
current.scope: USB + SD preserved · AUX not required
current.changes: Original source restored; inode9457 and checked metadata persisted through one normal software restart. Physical root read-only. Original/candidate/journal retained and verified after reboot.
current.display: Fresh Communication home after stock restart

milestones.title: Root access restored
milestones.detail: Fresh root55 identity and stock home observed after the incident.
milestones.proof: One known root login; uid0, Linux3.0.35, 55.00.750B/cmu150_NA, uptime454.06s, END0 + prompt and closed port.
milestones.limits: Separate recovery does not make the failed browser return successful. No complete boot trace or long-term stability claim.

milestones.title: Exact small-file exports
milestones.proof: Target pre/post MD5 + POSIX CRC + byte counts matched host; host SHA-256 retained.
milestones.limits: Two content copies, not a full-device backup, atomic snapshot or tested restore. No verified second copy.

milestones.title: Larger UART submission
milestones.detail: 7,093 B live submission passed with zero BEL.
milestones.proof: 6,699 B payload · CRC 158748838 · 3.198 s · 111 chunks / 110 gaps · END0 + prompt.
milestones.limits: One accepted profile. Earlier unpaced UNKNOWN is preserved; no universal flow-control claim.

milestones.title: Native dialog + owned cleanup
milestones.detail: One modal appeared and the display returned home.
milestones.proof: Live sleep4 first; exact owned TERM, wait143, cleanup0 and fresh root55. Process cleanup at +42 s.
milestones.limits: Full nonce was unreadable from glare/crop. After frame at +101 s missed the 90 s camera target; lifecycle success is separate from full visual/timing acceptance.

milestones.title: Clearer fresh camera frame
milestones.detail: Userspace UVC exposure control improved legibility.
milestones.proof: Requested manual mode1/exposure82; post-capture observed mode1/exposure87/brightness128 and retained it.
milestones.limits: Original mode8/exposure330/brightness128 preserved. Cause of 82→87 change unassigned; crop and angle remain. No raster processing.

milestones.title: Browser source mapped
milestones.detail: Running entry and exported Navigate binding verified.
milestones.proof: Installed run-Opera sets /jci/gui/index.html and launches with -u, matching live argv. Verified stock bootstrap is the timed-return target.
milestones.limits: Source mapping did not prove a safe reversible navigation experiment. Exact prior focus/history restoration is not claimed.

milestones.title: Browser demo: failed return
milestones.detail: Custom data page rendered; planned stock return failed.
milestones.proof: At about10s GUI_MANAGER missed heartbeat and Opera exited. Planned16s return got ServiceUnknown/rc1; SM logged reset intent. Initial after photo showed startup logo.
milestones.limits: Later fresh home/root recovery is separate. Navigation experiments stopped; only bounded stock heartbeat-source research continues.

milestones.title: Startup disclaimer bypass
milestones.detail: Independent one-line initial3500ms→0 prototype frozen; actual file write-and-restore passed on exact firmware55.
milestones.proof: Six feature checks, reviewed eight-check warm program, exact source/candidate hashes and live original→candidate→original readback. Stock OEM timeout/retry/teardown retained.
milestones.limits: Original is restored. Startup/no-flash, persistent install, USB maintenance and crash/power-loss recovery remain unvalidated.

milestones.title: Explicit host uninstall recovery
milestones.detail: 16 checks passed: 6 engine, 4 adapter and 6 completion checks.
milestones.proof: Default ABORT is unchanged. Opt-in COMPLETE restores the stored original from candidate, or verifies and commits an original already present without rewriting it.
milestones.limits: Host bytes/mode and process-exit model only. Target recovery policy, ownership restoration, power-loss behavior and USB entry point remain open.

milestones.title: CMU file operations on isolated fixtures
milestones.detail: One tmpfs trial and one writable RelFS trial passed with 22/23-byte synthetic files.
milestones.proof: Copy, same-parent replace/restore, metadata and checksum readback: 9 verified states and 16 tool statuses per trial. Both scratch directories removed; fresh root55 and normal completion.
milestones.limits: Runtime on the tested writable volumes only. Root RelFS, interrupted replacement, sync and crash/power-loss recovery were not tested.

milestones.title: Full-size disclaimer copy roundtrip
milestones.detail: 94,058 B original → 94,055 B frozen candidate → exact original, on an isolated CMU copy.
milestones.proof: 6.506 s; frozen byte recipe, 10 verified byte/attribute states, 17 tool statuses at zero, original source checked before/after, scratch removed and root55/core completion.
milestones.limits: The installed GUI was never changed or reloaded. No root RelFS, journal interruption, sync, crash recovery, startup/no-flash or power-loss claim.

milestones.title: Interrupted copy uninstall completed
milestones.detail: One two-phase CMU experiment: intended stop73 in 6.859 s, then explicit COMPLETE0 in 4.819 s.
milestones.proof: Four focused host checks passed. Live completion verified the same original inode/timestamp/bytes/mode/UID/GID, committed disabled/no-pending and removed the owned directory. Both phases had fresh root55 and normal core completion.
milestones.limits: Intentional process exit on isolated writable-volume copies only. No real GUI install, root remount, sync/crash/power-loss recovery or product policy adoption.

milestones.title: Actual GUI file written and restored
milestones.detail: One 12.155 s real-file original → candidate → original trial passed.
milestones.proof: Candidate and original count/MD5/CRC matched;0755/UID1018/GID3015/mtime restored, inode1606→9457 recorded. Both syncs, root-stage cleanup and physical RO verified. Fresh root55 and after-home image passed.
milestones.limits: Normal runtime on this bench only. Original is AS-FOUND; no startup/no-flash, full metadata, crash/power-loss or USB recovery claim. Backup/candidate/journal retained.

milestones.title: Recovery state verified independently
milestones.detail: One fresh-process read-only VERIFY passed in 2.049 s.
milestones.proof: Journal367 B parsed as data; stored original/candidate hashes and metadata matched. Current original9457 distinguished from historical1606; disabled/no-pending, noop1/writes0, actual physical RO and fresh root55 verified.
milestones.limits: VERIFY contains no restore/mount/sync branch. Restore capability is host-tested preparation only; no live recovery, reboot, crash/power-loss or USB guarantee follows.

milestones.title: Stock restart and persistence baseline
milestones.detail: Exactly one normal software reboot and one login; stock WARNING then Communication home observed.
milestones.proof: Changed boot ID, uptime17902→586s, fresh root55/NA, source original9457/checked metadata and physicalRO; O/C/journal contents and identities persisted. WARNING visibility bracket4.223–4.625s including fade from decoded frame PTS.
milestones.limits: Original automated observer timed out on logger-prefixed banner and remains UNKNOWN; separate agent-led postflight reconciled the result. Parser fix is offline-tested only. One warm stock run, no cold ACC/CarPlay, no-flash, crash/power-loss or USB recovery claim.

blockers.title: Automatic startup detector needs live confirmation
blockers.text: The executed observer missed the vendor logger-prefixed boot banner. Evidence and separate postflight verified the restart; a corrected parser passed offline checks/replay and has not yet run through a new live boot.

blockers.title: Hardware is in shipping
blockers.text: USB hub / Ethernet and USB ACC relay are expected in a few days. Arrival and agent-operable attachment gate those checks; no manual bench task is assigned to the user.

blockers.title: Browser heartbeat coupling
blockers.text: The custom page rendered but the timed return failed after heartbeat loss and Opera exit. Current root/home recovery is verified separately; navigation experiments remain stopped.

blockers.title: Firmware / retrofit compatibility
blockers.text: Firmware55 is below Mazda’s stated v70 retrofit-hub prerequisite. Exact hub identity and actual USB / SD behavior remain pending; this does not authorize a firmware upgrade.

blockers.title: Evidence coverage
blockers.text: Warm file restoration is verified. Full-device backup/restore, independent second-copy protection, startup behavior and crash/power-loss recovery remain open.

recent.title: Stock restart reconciled successfully
recent.text: One reboot/one login. New boot, original file, read-only root and retained recovery data verified without a second restart.

recent.title: Stock warning measured from real frames
recent.text: Visible-duration bracket4.223–4.625s including fade; about5FPS evidence. This is not an exact source timer or one-frame/no-flash measurement.

recent.title: Observer result preserved honestly
recent.text: Logger-prefixed banner escaped the original detector. Its UNKNOWN remains; a separate agent postflight completed verification and an offline-only parser correction is recorded.

recent.title: Stock restart stopped at preflight
recent.text: Custom vendor init was identified before any reboot request. A bounded read-only route investigation is active; this is not evidence that the stock reboot command is incompatible.

recent.title: Fresh recovery-state inspection passed
recent.text: An independent process verified the retained journal, backups and current original without writing anything. Next is a stock warm restart baseline.

recent.title: First actual file roundtrip passed
recent.text: Frozen candidate verified on the real CMU file, then original restored. Physical root is read-only; source inode changed as expected.

recent.title: Verified data delivery used for first write
recent.text: 12,756-byte reviewed script transferred as encoded data and checked on target. A short guarded entry invoked the exact file.

recent.title: Entry guard refusal preserved
recent.text: An unsupported grep-x check stopped the first entry before the body ran. Explicit correction reused the tested identity preflight; the body ran once.
